query:
UPDATE projects 
SET 
  description = 'In Fall 2024, I worked with Lumenati on Red Bull Jukebox, providing experiential design support focused on technical translation and fabrication documentation for this groundbreaking fan-powered live music experience. Red Bull Jukebox made its U.S. debut on October 2, 2024 at Ascend Amphitheater in Nashville, TN, featuring Brothers Osborne, Shaboozey, Priscilla Block, Tucker Wetmore, and more. The event gave fans unprecedented control over the setlist through interactive voting, creating a unique concert experience for over 6,800 attendees.

My role centered on analyzing an existing stage concept and transforming it into a set of detailed, fabrication-ready CNC drawings suitable for large-scale steel and aluminum construction. The primary scenic elements included a monumental LED wall arch and multiple layered façade components designed to frame the performance space and integrate seamlessly with LED content. These elements required precise segmentation to accommodate CNC cutting, transportation, and on-site assembly.

I broke the geometry into repeatable panels, carefully coordinating arc radii, connection points, and tolerances to ensure alignment across curved surfaces. Using Vectorworks, I developed elevation, section, and CNC layout drawings that translated the design intent into clear instructions for fabrication. Each component was labeled, dimensioned, and sequenced to support efficient CNC routing and assembly. Material considerations—including aluminum and MDF applications—were documented to align with structural requirements and LED integration.

A critical aspect of the process was collaboration with fabricators and trussing partners. The CNC files were coordinated to interface cleanly with truss systems, ensuring the scenic elements could be securely mounted while maintaining the visual continuity of the arch forms. Human-scale references were embedded into the drawings to verify proportion and sightline impact within the venue.

This project sits at the intersection of experiential design, scenic engineering, and digital fabrication. Rather than focusing on visual styling alone, the work emphasized precision, clarity, and buildability—ensuring the final installation could be realized efficiently while preserving the scale and impact of the original concept.',
  creativeTeam = '[{"name":"Gigi Rivera","role":"Account Manager"},{"name":"Clay Brassfield","role":"Head of Fabrication"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Technical Designer / CNC Documentation"}]',
  metadata = '{"venue":"Ascend Amphitheater","venueCapacity":"6,800","eventDate":"October 2, 2024","lumenatiLogo":"https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/JeNlQICToZmUdkNR.png","videoUrl":"https://www.redbull.com/us-en/videos/red-bull-jukebox-nashville-2024-brothers-osborne-it-aint-my-fault"}'
WHERE slug = 'red-bull-jukebox';
